news.title: Americans’ Views Of India Rebound—But Are More Polarized
news.summary_en: Democrats and Independents rate India more warmly than Republicans and are more supportive of high-skilled immigration from India and reducing tariffs on Indian goods.

news.title: Americans Say AI Benefits Are Not Worth the Risks
news.summary_en: Half of Americans also say artificial intelligence poses a critical threat to the vital interests of the United States over the next decade.
